title: Dabba
html:
• Theragāthā 1.5 Verses of the Senior Monks 1.5
  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Paṭhamavagga Chapter One

Dabbattheragāthā Dabba

“Yo duddamiyo damena danto, Once hard to tame, now tamed himself; Dabbo santusito vitiṇṇakaṅkho; proficient, content, with doubt overcome; Vijitāvī apetabheravo hi, victorious since his fears have vanished: Dabbo so parinibbuto ṭhitatto”ti. Dabba is steadfast, and has become fully quenched.

Itthaṁ sudaṁ āyasmā dabbo thero gāthaṁ abhāsitthāti. That is how this verse was recited by the senior venerable Dabba.
